notes.title: Play Krystopia: Nova´s Journey at Steam Game Festival!
notes.content:
Hey!

This is Antler Interactive and we´re happy to announce that we´ll be part of the Steam Game Festival - Summer Edition with our upcoming game, [b]Krystopia: Nova´s Journey.[/b]

During the festival you´ll get an exclusive look of the game and get to play the Demo for the first time. We´ll do a live stream and have a developer chat, where you can ask us about the game.

The length of the demo is around 30 minutes, depending on how savvy you are in solving puzzles!

Here´s what to expect from the Demo, where you´ll get to play the first part of Krystopia: Nova´s Journey:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36661047/32af315fe8f29fce617a3c0d8e90cf79de9fed00.jpg[/img]

In the role of space explorer Nova Dune, you need to observe the environment and navigate in a typical point and click-fashion to solve puzzles and progress through the game. You´ll get to collect relics and get early hints on why you´re on this mesmerizing planet you find yourself on. The mystery of Krystopia is what you´ll find out more about in the full game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36661047/c939310c506f4f85bb7b16827172fac62404b0c3.jpg[/img]

Trivia about us: We´re a Stockholm based studio with a mix of people from Sweden, France and Brazil. We were founded in 2016 and  have since taken pride in using puzzle gameplay mechanics, unique visuals and story-driven plots in our games.

Our previous games on Steam: Krystopia: A Puzzle Journey, Kartong: Death by Cardboard, Svrvive: The Deus Helix.

/Team Antler Interactive

notes.title: Krystopia selected for the NVIDIA® Indie Spotlight™ program!
notes.content:
We´re very happy to announce the great news that Krystopia: Nova´s Journey has been selected to participate in the NVIDIA® Indie Spotlight™ program. The program will include marketing exposure for the game which will help us reach out to even more players so they can enjoy the the atmospheric experience of Krystopia: Nova´s Journey. More exciting news to follow about the game:)
/Team Antler Interactive
